summary: The balloon plate is clean, but the butler strip shows no snatch or taut string, has a fast torso spin with a mangled arm, and crops his head.

faults.what: Facing away from camera, his near arm vanishes into the torso and the other hand sits behind his back with a bent, twisted wrist. The silhouette reads as a stump plus a floating hand, and it persists at 65.03.
faults.fix: Re-pose or retarget the arms during the turn so both arms stay readable and the wrist doesn't fold.
